'''House Mecandes''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Tear]]. It also has a branch in [[Cairhien]].

[[Cabriana Mecandes]], a [[Tairen]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]], hails from House Mecandes. Her much younger sister is [[Holleen Mecandes]], a [[Cairhienin]] [[Darkfriend]] who is married to [[Barris Mecandes]] and has a daughter, [[Elspeth Mecandes|Elspeth]].
